```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from html import escape

svg=['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="660" viewBox="0 0 1200 660" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
     '<title id="title">Un edifici en un model urbà i en un model constructiu</title>',
     '<desc id="desc">A l esquerra un edifici es relaciona amb el seu entorn urbà i diferencia coberta i façanes. A la dreta una vista esclatada mostra murs, forjats i un conducte amb propietats constructives.</desc>',
     '<rect width="1200" height="660" fill="#ffffff"/>',
     '<g font-family="Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#21313c">']
def text(x,y,s,bold=False,anchor="start"):
    svg.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" text-anchor="{anchor}" font-weight="{700 if bold else 400}">{escape(s)}</text>')
def poly(points,fill,stroke="#637780"):
    pts=" ".join(f"{x:.1f},{y:.1f}" for x,y in points)
    svg.append(f'<polygon points="{pts}" fill="{fill}" stroke="{stroke}" stroke-width="2"/>')
def p(x,y,z,ox,oy=300): return ox+40*x-24*y,oy+15*x+18*y-40*z
def face(xyz,ox,color,oy=300): poly([p(*q,ox,oy) for q in xyz],color)
def block(x,y,w,d,h,ox,colors):
    face([(x,y,0),(x+w,y,0),(x+w,y,h),(x,y,h)],ox,colors[0])
    face([(x+w,y,0),(x+w,y+d,0),(x+w,y+d,h),(x+w,y,h)],ox,colors[1])
    face([(x,y+d,0),(x+w,y+d,0),(x+w,y+d,h),(x,y+d,h)],ox,colors[0])
    face([(x,y,h),(x+w,y,h),(x+w,y+d,h),(x,y+d,h)],ox,colors[2])
def leader(points):
    pts=" ".join(f"{x:.1f},{y:.1f}" for x,y in points)
    svg.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="#637780" stroke-width="2"/>')
text(30,45,"a · Model urbà: CityGML",True)
text(630,45,"b · Model constructiu: BIM / IFC",True)
face([(-1,-2,0),(6,-2,0),(6,6,0),(-1,6,0)],230,"#f1f4f3")
block(0,-1,1.5,1.3,1.5,230,["#e1e7e9","#cfd9de","#edf1f2"])
block(4,.1,1.3,1.5,2.2,230,["#e1e7e9","#cfd9de","#edf1f2"])
block(.6,1,3,2.5,3,230,["#e0c295","#c89b6f","#b9654e"])
text(58,150,"coberta")
leader([(165,146),p(1.8,2,3,230)])
text(397,184,"façana")
leader([(405,195),p(3.6,2.2,1.5,230)])
text(290,554,"edifici E1 · ús residencial",anchor="middle")
text(290,616,"objectes urbans i superfícies",anchor="middle")

# Same main footprint, exploded for legibility. Layer offsets are diagrammatic.
ox,oy=865,427
for level in [0,2.1,5.8]:
    face([(0,0,level),(3,0,level),(3,2.5,level),(0,2.5,level)],ox,"#9dbdce",oy)
    face([(0,2.5,level-.16),(3,2.5,level-.16),(3,2.5,level),(0,2.5,level)],ox,"#567f95",oy)
face([(0,0,2.8),(3,0,2.8),(3,0,4.8),(0,0,4.8)],ox,"#e0c295",oy)
face([(3,0,2.8),(3,2.5,2.8),(3,2.5,4.8),(3,0,4.8)],ox,"#c89b6f",oy)
pipe=[p(.3,.7,1,ox,oy),p(1.4,.7,1,ox,oy),p(1.4,2.3,1,ox,oy)]
pts=" ".join(f"{x},{y}" for x,y in pipe)
svg.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="#b45c3b" stroke-width="8"/>')
text(640,133,"forjat · gruix")
leader([(812,141),p(.8,1.2,5.8,ox,oy)])
text(995,259,"mur")
text(995,295,"material")
leader([(985,303),p(3,1.2,3.7,ox,oy)])
text(640,365,"conducte")
text(640,401,"sistema")
leader([(785,393),pipe[1]])
text(900,554,"vista esclatada",anchor="middle")
text(900,616,"components i relacions",anchor="middle")
svg.extend(['</g>','</svg>'])
root=next(p for p in (Path.cwd(),*Path.cwd().parents) if (p/".unaltraweb/computations.yml").is_file())
out=root/"assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/citygml-bim.svg"
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text("\n".join(svg)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
```
